title: Healthcare Platform
description: A patient-facing healthcare app for doctor discovery and appointment booking, walking users from browsing specialists through slot selection to managing upcoming and past visits—with a production-ready NestJS + MongoDB API and Next.js + Material UI admin dashboard for platform management.
impact: End-to-end telehealth platform covering doctor discovery, appointment booking, patient profiles, and consultation flows across six platforms, with a matching backend API and admin dashboard for doctors, appointments, specialties, articles, and analytics.
responsibilities: Built a doctor directory browsable by specialty and rating with calendar-based appointment booking.
Implemented upcoming and past appointment management, reminders, and patient profiles with basic medical history.
Developed in-app messaging and consultation request flows with a clean, accessible Material 3 UI.
Delivered a NestJS + MongoDB REST API with JWT authentication and healthcare entity management.
Built a Next.js + Material UI admin dashboard for doctors, appointments, specialties, articles, users, and analytics.
achievements: Shipped a cross-platform telehealth experience for iOS, Android, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Backed the Flutter client with a contract-aligned API and staff admin tools for full platform operations.
Covered the complete patient journey from doctor discovery through booking, reminders, and health record access.
